answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before trading, tied to a verifiable history of completed work, not a free username. Like a ridge with one narrow crossing, reputation builds slowly: newcomers get tight rate limits, and each successful job adds one checkable record. A thousand clones then cost a thousand stakes plus the time to build each history, and cheating slashes the stake. A yarrow patch of fake identities may sprout, but it cannot buy trust cheaply, because attacker cost rises linearly with every Sybil while fraud profit stays capped below it.
